subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “It changed what visitors expected from it.”?
options: When basic facts are easy to get, human guides become valuable for what machines cannot provide: connection and judgment.
Human comfort matters, but so do the needs of small lives that disappear when nights become too bright.
In a modern store, human service may become less visible but more important.
Old crops can carry traits that become valuable again under new conditions.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「It changed what visitors expected from it. When basic facts are easy to get, human guides become valuable for what machines cannot…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Human comfort matters, but so do the needs of small lives that disappear when nights become too bright.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「In a modern store, human service may become less visible but more important.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Old crops can carry traits that become valuable again under new conditions.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「It changed what visitors expected from it. When basic facts are easy to get, human guides become valuable for what machines cannot provide: connection…」，答案為「When basic facts are easy to get, human guides become valuable for what machines cannot provide: connection and…」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「When basic facts are easy to get, human guides become valuable for what machines cannot provide: connection and…」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
